inputs.coverage: A flattened ellipsoid using the 54×50×26 km semi-axes measured by Karkoschka (2003) from Voyager 2 observations. Thalassa is only a few pixels across in the available images, often with motion trails, so those pixels cannot supply a registered terrain map. The standard gray grid marks unavailable surface imagery. Shared lighting describes the model shape; no craters or photographic detail are invented.
